stories.text: 🪦 Gather 'round: Joe's Scary Team's obituary has been posted (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: The Mahomies 32% / 5.3%, Mr. Action Jackson 47% / 19%.
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane clinches the #1 seed and a bye by winning both this week (the matchup with 49er Faith-Fool and the median).
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Gibb it to Me Baby vs Claremont In Yo Stace!, playoff odds win/loss: Gibb it to Me Baby 92.9%/70%, Claremont In Yo Stace! 95%/76%.
📈 COMEBACK: Brock You Like a Hurricane was down to 21% against 49er Faith-Fool — now 65% to win.
⚡ Early edge: Brock You Like a Hurricane went from 21% to 65% against 49er Faith-Fool.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 4 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 108.04 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 25.80 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Mr. Action Jackson: 59% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 16% with none (now 26%).
🕰️ Coulda-shoulda swap: If Kyle Tucker and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Tuten for Collins and Judkins back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+3 and +2 wins).
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane has all but locked up the #1 seed (99.5%).
🤔 What could have been: If Ramosverse and The Mahomies had swapped Washington and Hall for Williams and Metcalf back in Week 7, both would be ahead.
🎯 David Montgomery is 2.51 pts above ESPN projection for Ruffing the Passer.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7.2% against The Mahomies — and won.
💓 49er Faith-Fool outlasted TDsMaGee after the favorite flipped 3 times.
